renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. paragraphs.text: Just thisness — Your form, Lord, full of power-juice. Where sequence fails, time-reckoning melts by sheer force. By mind, by speech, by the senses outside, even by pots and pans — may I stand in that form all at once, without stopping.
